The '''Endrolia system''' was located in [[the Negs]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the beverage known as [[Endrolian ground-apple juice]].<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Endrolian ground-apple juice]]|system=Endrolia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Endrolia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-10.<ref name="TEA" />
